In this section, we identify two reasons why accuracy may degrade under certified unlearning via noisy fine-tuning (NFT), and propose two corresponding remedies. We first motivate block-wise noise injection to reduce the destructive effect of isotropic noise, and then motivate using a proximity parameter Δ ​ ( ρ ) \Delta(\rho) in place of worst-case model clipping.
